chat_rooms_kind_cuencada_check.name: chat_rooms_kind_cuencada_check
chat_rooms_kind_cuencada_check.value: ("kind" = 'global' and "cuencada_id" is null) or ("kind" = 'cuencada' and "cuencada_id" is not null)

cuencada_itinerary_items_tags_check.name: cuencada_itinerary_items_tags_check
cuencada_itinerary_items_tags_check.value: cardinality("tags") <= 6 and array_position("tags", null) is null

cuencada_itinerary_items_time_order_chec.name: cuencada_itinerary_items_time_order_check
cuencada_itinerary_items_time_order_chec.value: "start_time" is null or "end_time" is null or "end_time" > "start_time"

cuencadas_dates_check.name: cuencadas_dates_check
cuencadas_dates_check.value: ("starts_at" is null and "ends_at" is null) or ("starts_at" is not null and "ends_at" is not null and "ends_at" > "starts_at")

media_items_dimensions_check.name: media_items_dimensions_check
media_items_dimensions_check.value: ("width" is null or "width" > 0) and ("height" is null or "height" > 0) and ("duration_seconds" is null or "duration_seconds" >= 0)

people_years_order_check.name: people_years_order_check
people_years_order_check.value: "birth_year" is null or "death_year" is null or "death_year" >= "birth_year"

people_birth_date_year_check.name: people_birth_date_year_check
people_birth_date_year_check.value: "birth_date" is null or ("birth_year" is not null and extract(year from "birth_date") = "birth_year")

people_death_date_year_check.name: people_death_date_year_check
people_death_date_year_check.value: "death_date" is null or ("death_year" is not null and extract(year from "death_date") = "death_year")

people_dates_order_check.name: people_dates_order_check
people_dates_order_check.value: "birth_date" is null or "death_date" is null or "death_date" >= "birth_date"

people_photo_check.name: people_photo_check
people_photo_check.value: "photo_key" is null or "photo_updated_at" is not null

person_revisions_snapshots_check.name: person_revisions_snapshots_check
person_revisions_snapshots_check.value: ("before" is null or (jsonb_typeof("before") = 'object' and coalesce(jsonb_typeof("before" -> 'personId'), '') = 'string')) and ("after" is null or (jsonb_typeof("after") = 'object' and coalesce(jsonb_typeof("after" -> 'personId'), '') = 'string'))

person_revisions_has_snapshot_check.name: person_revisions_has_snapshot_check
person_revisions_has_snapshot_check.value: "before" is not null or "after" is not null

profiles_contact_visibility_check.name: profiles_contact_visibility_check
profiles_contact_visibility_check.value: jsonb_typeof("contact_visibility") = 'object' and ("contact_visibility" - array['whatsapp', 'instagram', 'facebook', 'tiktok', 'linkedin', 'github', 'website']::text[]) = '{}'::jsonb and not jsonb_path_exists("contact_visibility", '$.* ? (@.type() != "boolean")')

cuencada_rsvps_dates_check.name: cuencada_rsvps_dates_check
cuencada_rsvps_dates_check.value: "arrival_date" is null or "departure_date" is null or "departure_date" >= "arrival_date"
